title: PRESSER | Luke Hasz - Mississippi State Preview (11-24-26)
text: Uh, two touchdowns last week. Just how did it feel finding a rhythm, especially early? Cuz I mean, it's had been since week two since you guys scored on an opening drive. >> [snorts] >> Yeah, it felt good. I feel like a good week of preparation and then uh, it was cool just to I got a lot of energy from Caleb's catch right before that. Um, so it was just good to go out there and execute and definitely felt good to get in the end zone. >> You're also going into your second Egg Bowl. Um, just what have you learned about the Egg Bowl from last year and now this year going into your going into this one? >> Yeah, definitely means a lot, especially uh, just hearing from like coaches that have played here and people that have lived like pretty much their whole life in this state, just how much it means um, this game means and the importance of it and then just definitely knowing that we're going to get their best shot and everything that they got and um, they're a great team and we've been preparing well this week. >> What was the the Tom Luke speech like? >> Oh yeah, every year it's uh, if it doesn't get you going, you got something wrong with you. I mean, just the way that like like his story with it's like really deep and meaningful to him and it kind of impacts us and we kind of just feed off of him about it. But it's it's incredible. >> You might if it's public, what like what is the story? >> Yeah, I mean he I think about he just uh, whenever he played here uh, this game meant a lot to him and he only lost one game and he still remembers it like to this day and he wish wishes he could do anything to get it back and he just has a bunch of other stuff with the story that's really impactful and uh, helps fire us up. >> Senior day was uh, a little bit different I think with the five for five rule and things like that. Is I mean, seems like you probably want to use that next year of eligibility. Is it like weird balancing that between like going through the middle of this season and then figuring out what's next? >> Yeah, I mean it's kind of similar like like last year cuz I mean you're trying to figure out what you want to do, but ultimately uh, we still have a lot of games to play the rest of the season and uh, for me personally I def I'll I'll definitely [snorts] be that and um I just feel like uh it's been great this year to play with my teammates and then come back next year and play again. >> What have you liked about uh your new position coach? >> Uh I've loved uh playing under him. He's done a great job with our room just helping us come together and bond and he teaches the game on like a really personal level and like we're all super close and like uh he can tell us whatever we need to hear and be truthful about it and we are coachable about it. >> What's your read on Mississippi State? >> What was that say it again? >> Yeah just from film or whatever what's kind of your read on what Mississippi State does? >> Yeah they do a lot on defense uh especially last year playing against them it'll be like my third time playing them. They do a lot uh up front and junk it up and twist and stuff so um we've done a great job this week preparing for that. >> There's been I I think every guy we've talked to so far has been 100% in on the Egg Bowl and no hesitation. What does that say about the culture that Pete Golding is built here at Ole Miss? >> Yeah I say it just goes back to the guys who recruited and uh why he recruited them and uh why we're all in here together and I mean it shows that everyone is 100% focused on playing this game and the game after that. >> Questions? Good. Thanks. Thank you.
